newsitem.title: FRANCE: French building company stocks fall sharply.
newsitem.headline: French building company stocks fall sharply.

text.p: Shares in French building companies showed the biggest falls on Friday after two reports painting a grim outlook for the industry, brokers said.
French newspapers reported on Thursday that an industry association and a government study showed as many as 30,000 workers could lose their jobs in the industry because of slow business.

Shares in Bouygues were 2.38 percent lower at 533 francs. Eiffage shares were 5.05 percent lower at 188 francs, and Generale des Eaux shed 1.44 percent at 1100 GMT. The CAC-40 index was down 1.4 percent.
